linuxRunnerDependencies.reason: Private X11 runner initially lacked xvfb-run/xauth, then dvdauthor environment-check command. Debian packages were extracted only under ignored _bin/webm-test-tools; no system package installed.

staleNativeRunner.reason: Early native runs used an outdated release binary; repeated after rebuild. An audio mutation fixture also had the wrong CodecID length and was corrected before the final 159-case run.

windowsSshOutput.reason: Initial CTest log records 80 PASS, but SSH output decoder failed on a CP1251 warning after teardown. CTest exit was not captured, so it was repeated with the actual exit written on Windows and its log redirected there; final exit 0.

msvcHeaderMacro.reason: An early build rejected a local identifier named small, which conflicts with a Windows RPC macro. Renamed to bits32; final MSVC build exit 0.

limitations: Separate VP9 video and Opus audio WebM only; known VOD duration, DefaultDuration video, known-size clusters, no lacing/encryption
Native index covers Opus mono/stereo; end-to-end new WebM playback corpus uses Opus stereo with 8/10-bit VP9
Qt verifies active audio codec/rate and changing decoded frames; Classic verifies graph/status and decoder reads, without optical/physical output measurement
No physical A/V synchronization, 30-minute drift, HDR/10-bit final Qt surface or 4K realtime qualification
Other WebM codecs, arbitrary MKV/Ogg, muxed/remux, segments/live, metadata and real Harvester integration remain outstanding
Installed Windows EXE/profiles unchanged; hardware and Wayland excluded; YouTubeHarvester unchanged
